basic_details.job_title: GAD Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government of Mizoram, General Administration Department, Secretariat Administration Wing (GAD), Aizawl, has invited applications for 10 posts of Driver (Provisional Employee) under Advt No. 3 of 2026-2027. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 16 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Not specified, but must be submitted with application form.

qualification.education_qualification: Passed Class VIII or above from a recognized institution; valid driving licence (LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV PSVBUS); minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency.
qualification.details: Qualification: Passed in Class VIII or above from recognized Institution; Valid driving licence in any of: Light Motor Vehicle - Non-Transport (LMV-NT); Transport Vehicle - Medium/Heavy Motor Vehicle (Rigid Chassis) - Goods (TRANS); or Transport Vehicle - Medium/Heavy Motor Vehicle (Rigid Chassis) - Public Service Vehicle (PSVBUS); Minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government from time to time Age limit: 18 to 35 years Age relaxation: ST/SC Up to 40 years, Ex-servicemen Up to the applicable age limit approved by the State Government | Other conditions: | Valid driving licence in LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV Public Service Vehicle (PSVBUS) Minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government

exam_pattern.details: Answers marked with blue or black ball point pen; at least four options per question Over marking / overwriting an answer is considered a wrong answer Additional time of 40 minutes per paper for Visually handicapped / Cerebral palsy candidates Questions set in tune with the level of educational qualifications in the Recruitment Rules/Service Rules

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form from GAD, SAW (E), Mizoram Secretariat Building No.1 Room No.052/053 (Basement-I), MINECO, Aizawl during office hours, or download it from sad.mizoram.gov.in.
Submit the duly filled application form to GAD, SAW (E) on or before 16-12-2026, 3:30 PM, along with the application fee.
Government servants must apply through proper channel.
important_instructions: Government servants must apply through proper channel Any incomplete application will be summarily rejected by the Department Of the 10 posts, 7 are Unreserved and 3 are Ex-servicemen posts

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 16 December 2026 Vacancies: 10 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: ST/SC/OBC: Rs. 150; General: Rs. 200 Pay: Rs. 13,520 per month Age limit: 18 to 35 years Place: Aizawl

rows.government_of_mizoram_general_administra: Passed Class VIII or above from a recognized institution; valid driving licence (LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV PSVBUS); minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency.
GAD, SAW (E), Mizoram Secretariat Building No.1 Room No.052/053 (Basement-I), MINECO, Aizawl

content_sections.heading: GAD Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 3 of 2026-2027 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GAD notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Passed in Class VIII or above from recognized Institution; Valid driving licence in any of: Light Motor Vehicle - Non-Transport (LMV-NT); Transport Vehicle - Medium/Heavy Motor Vehicle (Rigid Chassis) - Goods (TRANS); or Transport Vehicle - Medium/Heavy Motor Vehicle (Rigid Chassis) - Public Service Vehicle (PSVBUS); Minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government from time to time Age limit: 18 to 35 years Age relaxation: ST/SC Up to 40 years, Ex-servicemen Up to the applicable age limit approved by the State Government Other conditions: Valid driving licence in LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV Public Service Vehicle (PSVBUS) Minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Not specified, but must be submitted with application form.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application (3:30 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will GAD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination: Paper-I (General Knowledge, General English, Essay Writing, English Comprehension) - 200 marks Written examination: Paper-II (Simple Arithmetic, General Intelligence & Reasoning) - 200 marks Paper-I Part-A: General Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), General English (25 questions, 50 marks) Paper-I Part-B: Essay Writing (30 marks), English Comprehension (20 marks) Paper-II: Simple Arithmetic (50 questions, 100 marks), General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 questions, 100 marks) Grand total 400 marks

content_sections.heading: GAD Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Answers marked with blue or black ball point pen; at least four options per question Over marking / overwriting an answer is considered a wrong answer Additional time of 40 minutes per paper for Visually handicapped / Cerebral palsy candidates Questions set in tune with the level of educational qualifications in the Recruitment Rules/Service Rules

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GAD Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from GAD, SAW (E), Mizoram Secretariat Building No.1 Room No.052/053 (Basement-I), MINECO, Aizawl during office hours, or download it from sad.mizoram.gov.in. Submit the duly filled application form to GAD, SAW (E) on or before 16-12-2026, 3:30 PM, along with the application fee. Government servants must apply through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Government servants must apply through proper channel Any incomplete application will be summarily rejected by the Department Of the 10 posts, 7 are Unreserved and 3 are Ex-servicemen posts

content_sections.heading: GAD Driver (Provisional Employee) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GAD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GAD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies for Driver (Provisional Employee).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GAD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (GAD, SAW (E) office during office hours, or Department website sad.mizoram.gov.in) and send it to GAD, SAW (E), Mizoram Secretariat Building No.1 Room No.052/053 (Basement-I), MINECO, Aizawl, by by hand or post to the specified office address, to reach by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ST/SC/OBC: Rs. 150. General: Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years. Relaxation: ST/SC Up to 40 years, Ex-servicemen Up to the applicable age limit approved by the State Government.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 13,520 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed Class VIII or above from a recognized institution; valid driving licence (LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV PSVBUS); minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid driving licence in LMV-NT, Transport Vehicle MHMV Goods (TRANS) or Transport Vehicle MHMV Public Service Vehicle (PSVBUS). Minimum score in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination: Paper-I (General Knowledge, General English, Essay Writing, English Comprehension) - 200 marks. Written examination: Paper-II (Simple Arithmetic, General Intelligence & Reasoning) - 200 marks. Paper-I Part-A: General Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), General English (25 questions, 50 marks). Paper-I Part-B: Essay Writing (30 marks), English Comprehension (20 marks).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is of Provisional Employee.
